mechanism: Haloperidol may deplete coenzyme Q10 levels through inhibition of HMG-CoA reductase pathway and increased oxidative stress, potentially reducing CoQ10's antioxidant neuroprotective effects.
action: Monitor for increased extrapyramidal side effects and consider CoQ10 supplementation if deficiency symptoms emerge; baseline CoQ10 levels may be warranted in long-term haloperidol therapy.
